admission.justification: The dashboard generation checks and the host snapshot refresh together prevent a stale feature answer from controlling a refreshed selection.

applicability: An explicit Refresh of the role launcher.
conditions: Refresh drops old answers and selected-model discovery waits for the matching new metadata generation.
exclusions: A post-Start metadata reread does not clear the held answers.

evidence: Dashboard refresh cases and W5 pinned Refresh ordering over the 350-model fixture. CUR-F01 guide-to-source comparison and current mounted tests.

statement: Refresh renews the provider snapshot before listing models and requesting the shown model's options.
